title: QUIC Advisory Peer Characterization Matrix Pilot Work Item
summary: Add an advisory peer-characterization matrix overlay that records peer, role, testcase, outcome class, failure class, and artifact root for mixed interop results, seeded by connectionmigration, expanded into the major-peer matrix inventory, and preserved as a completed major-peer evidence report, without changing runtime behavior or CI gates.
planned_changes:
- Add a matrix interpretation layer that captures each interop cell's peer slot, local role, testcase, outcome class, failure class, and artifact root instead of flattening mixed outcomes to green/red.
- Seed the first rows from the current connectionmigration proof and blocked comparison bundles, then reuse the same classification shape for the currently executable non-HTTP/3 major-peer matrix cells.
- Emit a generated advisory seed report under `specs/generated/quic/interop-peer-characterization-matrix-pilot.json` and `.md` so the pilot has a repo-native overlay surface.
- Emit a generated advisory major-peer inventory report under `specs/generated/quic/interop-major-peer-matrix-inventory.json` and `.md` so the current `REQ-QUIC-INT-0019` cell set is explicit and reviewable.
- Emit a generated advisory major-peer evidence report under `specs/generated/quic/interop-major-peer-matrix-evidence-25904716076.json` and `.md` so the completed hosted run is preserved with per-cell failure classes.
- Keep the current helper dispatch shapes, peer aliases, and ordinary CI gates unchanged.
- Update current-status and gap notes so the pilot is recorded as advisory analysis rather than support promotion.
- Add or adjust focused tests around `InteropRunnerScriptFailureSummaryTests.cs` and the existing requirement-home tests so the matrix rows remain traceable to `REQ-QUIC-INT-0019` and `REQ-QUIC-INT-0022`.
- Keep the external runner repository untouched for the pilot; the matrix should be derived from repo-local helper output and preserved artifact bundles.
out_of_scope: treating mixed peer failures as green/red support proof
making the matrix blocking in CI
solving the underlying NEQO-specific failure first
verification_plan: Review the current proof bundles and dry-run plans, confirm the report surface can enumerate peer, role, testcase, outcome class, failure class, and artifact-root rows, run focused helper and requirement-home tests for `REQ-QUIC-INT-0019` and `REQ-QUIC-INT-0022`, verify the generated seed report files, the generated major-peer inventory report files, and the completed major-peer evidence report files, and dispatch a fresh hosted comparison run only after the matrix layer exists so the heterogeneous outcomes remain classifiable.
